Thirty physical and mathematical derivation plates separate established relations and their validity conditions from the book's unvalidated research heuristics. The NQ-14 deployment expression is a conceptual four-gate test: adequate evidence, valid authority, verified recovery and compliance with the applicable regulatory pathway are jointly necessary. Its Boolean structure is not a proof of safety or legal status, nor can a composite index replace consequence-specific vetoes. AI models do not obtain permission to diagnose or treat patients through inference quality. Clinical uses would require qualified professional oversight, intended-use evidence, independent validation, ethical governance and applicable jurisdiction-specific regulatory processes. Relevant context includes BIPM/JCGM metrology guidance, IMDRF SaMD clinical evaluation documents and FDA guidance on AI device software change management, none of which is presented as approval of the proposed platform. The thirty derivation plates are research-level derivation sketches rather than complete textbook proofs; the 233 numbered equation eggs are not discoveries of 233 new physical laws.
